Interface CustomToolType

All Superinterfaces:
Registrable
@NullMarked public interface CustomToolType extends Registrable
Represents a ToolType which holds information about how a tool of this type should behave when turned into an actual item.

    • miningLevel

      int miningLevel()
      Returns the mining level of this ToolType. If the mining level of the tool is lower than the mining level of the block being mined, the block will not drop anything. 0-4 represent the vanilla values, which are as follows:
      - 0: Wood, Gold
      - 1: Stone, Copper
      - 2: Iron
      - 3: Diamond
      - 4: Netherite
      Returns:
      the mining level

    • includeVanillaMineables

      boolean includeVanillaMineables()
      Returns if this ToolType includes the vanilla "mineable/" tags whose materials will be considered as correct for this ToolType. E.g., if the material of this ToolType is a pickaxe, it will include the tag "mineable/pickaxe", meaning all íncluded entries in that tag, will now be considered correct for this ToolType. Will be overwritten with the default speed set for this ToolType if not disabled, see overwriteVanillaMineables().
      Returns:
      if vanilla "mineable/" tag materials are considered correct for this ToolType

    • overwriteVanillaMineables
